title: Send mutes to the backend so a muted kind costs nothing
paras: Muting is a `localStorage` filter. A muted **Coaching** kind still triggers a Haiku call for every substantial interviewer turn (at most one per 20 s), and muted probes still cost a Sonnet call per analysed answer. The cards are produced, sent and thrown away.

Add a `set_copilot_mutes` message that stores `muted_kinds` in graph state; `dispatch` and `peer_sends` skip a node whose only output is a muted kind. Keep the local filter for instant feedback. Deterministic signals can keep running since they are free.
